architecture.core_loop: DIRECTION -> DISCOVER -> SCORE -> DEDUPE -> BITE -> RECEIPT -> CHECKPOINT -> NEXT
architecture.scout: metadata-first discovery across configured public sources; current adapters: arXiv, Zenodo, GitHub repository search, RSS/Atom
architecture.grazer: bounded resumable consumption of explicitly approved large objects; current adapters: UWA HDF5/MAT-v7.3 via Ocean Beetle and generic HTTP-range text
architecture.direction_contract: human/JANUS direction lives on main; execution does not invent autonomous purpose
architecture.memory_contract: runner is disposable; seen ids, cursors, candidate inbox, provenance receipts and large-object checkpoints live on beetle-state
architecture.persistence: each successful run commits changed state back to beetle-state
architecture.dedupe: candidate identity is hash-bound to source + canonical URL + title

notable_candidate.title: Open-Set Vessel Re-Identification from Underwater Ship-Radiated Noise with a Raw-Waveform Selective-Kernel Acoustic Neural Network (SKANN) and a Cross-Passage Evaluation Protocol
notable_candidate.reason: directly relevant to Ocean Reader source-identity/provenance recovery; explicitly distinguishes vessel identity from recording-channel confounds

operational_boundary.large_objects: must be explicitly placed in grazer_tasks before body ingestion

next_direction_interface: To steer the Beetle, edit data/beetle/directions.json: add/disable a direction, change keywords/sources, or explicitly approve a new grazer task.
seal: THE BEETLE MAY SEARCH WITHOUT RESTING; IT MAY NOT CHOOSE WHAT IS TRUE. DIRECTION GUIDES THE MOUTH, PROVENANCE REMEMBERS EVERY BITE.
